extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from XML results/methods, figure captions, PDF text, and supplementary MALDI-TOF-only PDF.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: OIR3 has source-supported LPS/endotoxin binding and neutralization activity relative to the engineered peptide panel, supported by BODIPY-TR-cadaverine displacement and SPR assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: OIR3 compared with IR3, DIR3, and GS where reported
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact plotted curve points were not extracted from figure images.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: OIR3 disrupts bacterial membranes in source assays, including outer membrane permeabilization, inner membrane permeability, depolarization, PI uptake, and SEM/TEM morphology.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: primarily OIR3 against E. coli UB1005/ATCC 25922 and S. aureus ATCC 29213, with comparators where reported
mechanism_claims.limitations: Quantified PI-positive percentages in section 2.10 are source text; other figure curves are qualitative.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: OIR3 reduces LPS-stimulated TNF-alpha production in RAW264.7 cells and reduces cytokine mRNA markers in the oxazolone ear inflammation model.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: OIR3 anti-inflammatory activity in RAW264.7 cells and mouse ear tissue model
direct_assay_types: qPCR for TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta mRNA
mechanism_claims.limitations: Anti-inflammatory functional evidence, not a direct antimicrobial killing endpoint.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Only values present in source text/tables were curated numerically; figure-only curve points were not fabricated.
